findings.claim: Q2's rationale puts Swedish quotation marks around a phrase that occurs nowhere in the unit, so a student who tries to locate it in the passage will fail; it is the only non-textual quoted span in the whole unit (12 of 13 quoted spans are verbatim).
findings.evidence: Q2 rationale: "Fällan är stark för en textblind läsare, eftersom ”för mycket administration, för lite verksamhet” är den vanligaste kommunkritiken." Substring scan of the shipped passage + all stems + all options: 'administration' occurs 0 times, 'verksamhet' 0 times (only 'verksamma' in P1, 'den minst verksamma'). A programmatic re-quote check of every ”…”-delimited span in both rationales returns 12/13 verbatim hits (passage or current option text) and this one miss. The same scan over every shipped LÄS unit in batches 1–11 finds no other genuine non-textual quoted span.
findings.why: Integrated checklist row 4 (rationale ↔ current option/passage) is the rationale's contract with the student: quotation marks in this corpus signal 'find this in the text'. Here they mark a rhetorical slogan about municipal criticism in general, which is legitimate content but should be unquoted or italicised. Cosmetic, consistent with the recorded MINOR_NOTES — not a verdict flip.

findings.claim: The first of the two arguments Q1's rationale gives against option A relies on a scope assumption the passage never states: that the two rental areas belong to the stem's subset (groups meeting physically at least twice a year). Only the second argument, added in the final revision, is airtight.
findings.evidence: Option A is scoped — "I samtliga områden med regelbundna träffar minskade inbrotten kraftigt, oavsett …". The rationale rebuts it with "undantaget står uttryckligen i texten — i de två hyresrättsområdena ”gick det inte att mäta någonting alls”". The passage sentence is unscoped as to meeting frequency: "Utslaget på tipsen var tydligast i villaområden med låg omflyttning. I två hyresrättsområden, där ungefär en tredjedel av hushållen hade bytts ut under perioden, gick det inte att mäta någonting alls." Nothing says those two areas met physically twice a year, so strictly they need not falsify A's restricted claim. The candidates-corrected → candidates-final diff shows the stage saw this and appended the decisive reason: "Framför allt är A fel redan i sak: nedgången i anmälda inbrott var enligt texten så svag att den inte gick att skilja från jämförelseområdenas, så inbrotten minskade inte ”kraftigt” i de områden frågan gäller."
findings.why: Rationale accuracy is the pedagogy stage's probe 3, and the teaching payload is now correct because the appended argument settles A on its own; the residual is a first argument that is defensible-by-reading rather than stated. Minor, and it is exactly the class the recorded MINOR_FIXES verdict covers — the record is confirmed, not refuted.

clean_checks.language: Worked the LÄS hunt-list row by row on the shipped text; no lethal/major defect survives. Verb collocations are native ('köper in', 'tyna bort', 'rår ingen samordnare på', 'är återhållsam med slutsatser', 'rymmer ett fall', 'ringer runt', 'kallar till möte'). No passive-infinitive misuse: the N att V-inf frame is active ('fler skyltar att sätta upp'), and option B's 'för svag för att skiljas från' is the licensed 'för + adj + för att + passivinfinitiv' frame with 'skilja A från B' in its distinguish sense ('kopian kan inte skiljas från originalet'). BIFF is correct in all 15 subordinate clauses ('att den inte gick att skilja', 'ett fall hon inte kan förklara', 'som knappast bryr sig om en skylt', 'Där grupperna verkligen träffades', 'oftare säger sig känna'); main-clause V2 holds throughout, incl. the topicalised 'Det har jag inte forskat på' and the idiomatic 'i flera områden mer än fördubblades de'. Gender/definiteness clean ('den synligaste delen', 'ett litet resultat', 'den sortens resultat', 'inbrotten', 'En del av tipsen'); the title's equative 'Skyltarna är det billiga i grannsamverkan' is correct non-agreeing identification, not a plural-agreement slip. Register is signed debattartikel throughout, no chat/blog intrusion. The G-SPRAK calque 'känna sina grannar vid namn' is genuinely repaired to the settled collocation 'känna sina grannar till namnet' in the shipped file. Em dashes (—) are house convention: every one of the 26 shipped LÄS passages in batches 1–11 uses them.
clean_checks.key_sanity: Both keys are single-best and defensible to a complaining student. Q1=B: the stem scopes to areas meeting physically ≥2×/year, and P2 gives exactly B's two limbs ('steg antalet tips till polisen kraftigt' / 'så svag att den inte gick att skilja'). C is a straight swap of the two measures; A asserts a 'kraftig' burglary drop the passage denies; D reports the chat-only paragraph, where 'antalet tips som nådde polisen förändrades inte'. B's elliptical genitive 'jämförelseområdenas' is licensed: if the fall could not be told apart from the comparison areas' development, that development was of the same order. Q2=C: P4 states her invändning verbatim in substance ('handlar inte om för lite pengar' / 'vad pengarna går till' / 'bekostar skyltar, dekaler och foldrar, men inte den person som kallar till möte'). A inverts the budget priority; B promotes the travelling-groups concession, which the next sentence refuses ('Det är ändå inget skäl att låta bli'); D attributes a doubt about the trygghetsmätning that the text never voices — it cites the measurement approvingly. No second defensible option in either question.
clean_checks.fact_check: Every factual claim in both rationales holds against the shipped passage: the finding sits in stycke 2 (paragraph indices verified); the tips/burglary asymmetry, the chat-group message-vs-tips distinction, the two rental areas, the author's stance and her explicit refusal of the travelling-groups conclusion, and the last paragraph's approving use of the trygghetsmätning are all as described. Both rationales attribute stance to 'hon', matching the byline 'Ellinor Wredberg'. No real-world claim is made that could be false: all entities (Petra Nyhlén, Almnäs högskola, Vallsäter kommun, Ellinor Wredberg) are fictional and no real study or thesis is anchored.
clean_checks.verbatim_quotes: Programmatic re-quote check against the SHIPPED file: 7/7 quoted spans in Q1 and 5/6 in Q2 appear verbatim in the current passage or current option text (the 13th is the non-textual slogan reported above). The language correction ('vid namn' → 'till namnet') orphaned nothing: no rationale quotes that clause. The Q1 rationale was itself re-cut in candidates-final to re-anchor its opening quote ('där grupperna träffades fysiskt ”steg antalet tips till polisen kraftigt…”'), and that new wording matches the passage exactly.
clean_checks.leak_and_metadata: No cross-question leak: Q1 lives in P2/P3 (empirical finding), Q2 in P4 (stance); neither question's options disclose the other's answer. No self-contradiction inside or between rationales. Trap labels reconcile with las/families.json's glossary, which defines reversed_causality as 'Rätt element, fel riktning … (textens "tvärtom")' — this licenses both the Q1 outcome swap and the Q2 stance inversion, and matches the batch-10 precedent for stance-level use. Metadata accurate: keys B/C match key_spread, question families match the stems (Q1 is content-anchored, no 'enligt texten' formula → detalj_ospecificerad; Q2 → forfattarens_hallning), planted_traps letters match the options and the rationale labels, glossary defines 'trygghetsmätning' in base form and the word occurs in P5. run_mech.py on the shipped file: M-SCHEMA / M-BANDS / M-TELL / M-FORM / M-PLAGIARISM all pass; key is not the longest option in either question (Q1 19 vs 20 words, Q2 14 vs 18) and key position is spread.
clean_checks.not_reported: G-STEM's recorded 'PARTIALLY' flags (blind pick B-or-C on Q1, C-leaning on Q2) are real but already recorded in report.json under status SURVIVED_FLAGGED, so they are not a stage miss. The near-verbatim overlap of Q2's key with P4 ('men inte den person som') is within corpus norms and M-PLAGIARISM passes.
